crossRefs.note: “You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.
Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord Yahweh.
Three times in a year all of your males shall appear before Yahweh your God in the place which he chooses: in the feast…
They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.
He said, “Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have fought with God and with men, and have…
He erected an altar there, and called it El Elohe Israel.

parallels.note: Three times in a year all of your males shall appear before Yahweh your God in the place which he chooses: in the feast…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord Yahweh, the God of Israel.
translations.bsb: Three times a year all your males are to appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.
translations.kjv: Thrice in the year shall all your men children appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.
translations.asv: Three times in the year shall all thy males appear before the Lord Jehovah, the God of Israel.
